items.title: Is It Worth Investing in PPL (PPL) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
items.summary: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), PPL (PPL) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?

items.title: PPL increases capital plan to $25B with proposed Kentucky gas plant
items.summary: The company projects some 50 GW of potential load growth, mostly from data centers, across Kentucky and Pennsylvania. CEO Vincent Sorgi suggested those states could see a influx of projects due to restrictions in other regions.

items.title: PPL Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Higher Growth and Data Center Demand
items.summary: PPL raises its long-term earnings growth target to 7-9%, backed by a $25 billion capital plan and rising data center demand in Pennsylvania and Kentucky.

items.summary: A Democratic takeover of Congress could boost clean energy policy support, while rising AI power demand creates opportunities for four stocks.

items.title: Does PPL (PPL) Change The Story With Raised EPS Targets And A $25 Billion Plan?
items.summary: PPL (NYSE:PPL) reported strong Q3 2026 earnings and raised its long term EPS growth target on 7 November 2026. Management outlined a US$25b capital investment plan running through 2030 across its regulated utility operations. Invitium Energy, PPL's joint venture, agreed to supply 2 GW of power to a large Pennsylvania data center customer. PPL's stronger Q3 2026 earnings, higher EPS goal and 2030 capital plan deserve weighing against our broader PPL view. Our analysis turns up 2 warning signs...
